worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.summary: Two venomous blades snap shut from either side and scissor an X into the target, catching others on the narrow line between them; those cut get a first poison roll, then the venom in the cut seeps in a moment later at a higher chance. Corrode form is more toxic but cuts lighter; Edge form cuts harder but lands poison less often.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.descriptio: The scissor deals %1$s contact damage to the target in front, with a reach of %2$s blocks.
The scissor line is %1$s blocks half-wide; others caught take %2$s of the power, and the venom seeps %3$s after the blades close.
Those cut get a first poison roll at %1$s, then a seep roll at %2$s to poison them for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.corrode.on: Corrode form: first poison x1.2, seep chance x1.3, poison duration x1.15; costs scissor power x0.9 and slower windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.corrode.of: Edge form: cuts harder and faster; costs a harder time pressing poison into the wound.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.growth.0: From level %1$s the scissor power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.growth.1: From level %1$s the scissor power is %2$s and the seep chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.0: A simultaneous pincer that finishes one target
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.1: Clip anyone crowding in beside the target
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.2: Leave poison that seeps from the cut
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.preference: On: first poison x1.2, seep chance x1.3, poison duration x1.15, but scissor power x0.9 and slower windup and cooldown - for winning on poison. Off (Edge form): cuts harder and faster, but poison is harder to press in.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; the reach is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
When on, a target not already poisoned ranks higher so the two poison rolls are not wasted; when off all targets rank alike.
When on, a target with another enemy on the scissor line beside it ranks higher, so one pincer clips two; when off it only judges the target itself.
